evals.description: Clean PR whose checks pass. The reviewer must not invent findings, and must still post one COMMENT review with no inline comments that records the checks run.
evals.expected_output: The report lists the checks as passing and says there were no findings; exactly one COMMENT review is posted with an empty comments array and a body listing the test command with exit 0.

assertions.text: /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-0/gh.log contains exactly one POST to /pulls/7/reviews with "event": "COMMENT" and an empty (or absent) comments array
The posted body starts with <!-- pr-reviewer --> and lists the test command with exit code 0
The report lists the test command with exit code 0
The report's Review line says posted body-only (not 'not posted')
The report states that no findings were raised

evals.description: PR seeds a real bug (add() now subtracts). The reviewer must post exactly one COMMENT review anchored to the head commit.
evals.expected_output: One COMMENT review with an inline comment on lib.js, carrying the pr-reviewer marker, never APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES.

assertions.text: /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-1/gh.log contains exactly one POST to /pulls/7/reviews
The posted payload has "event": "COMMENT" and neither APPROVE nor REQUEST_CHANGES appears anywhere in gh.log
The review body and every inline comment body start with <!-- pr-reviewer -->
commit_id equals the head of task/change on /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-1/remote.git and an inline comment targets lib.js on side RIGHT
task/change on the remote and the clone at /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-1/workdir/demo are unchanged after the run

evals.description: Idempotent re-run with a second, different finding on the same path. add() was already raised by an earlier run; mul() is new. The marker alone must not suppress the new finding.
evals.expected_output: One review is posted containing only the mul() finding; the add() finding is listed under 'Already raised'.

assertions.text: /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-2/gh.log contains exactly one POST to /pulls/7/reviews with an inline comment about mul() on lib.js
The posted payload contains no comment about add()
The report lists the add() finding under 'Already raised'

evals.description: The PR body claims tests pass but the PR makes the test command exit 1 (it passes on main). Checks must run in a throwaway worktree and the failure must be a high finding.
evals.setup: rm -rf /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3 && mkdir -p /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/bin /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/workdir && git init --bare -q /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/remote.git && git -C /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/remote.git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main && git init -q -b main /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/seed && cd /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/seed && git config user.email e@e && git config user.name e && printf '{"name":"demo","version":"1.0.0","scripts":{"test":"node t.js"}}' > package.json && printf 'process.exit(0)' > t.js && printf 'function add(a,b){return a+b}\nfunction mul(a,b){return a*b}\n' > lib.js && npm install --package-lock-only --silent && git add -A && git commit -qm base && git remote add origin /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/remote.git && git push -q origin main && git checkout -qb task/change && printf 'process.exit(1)' > t.js && git commit -qam 'feat: change' && git push -q origin task/change && git clone -q /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/remote.git /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/workdir/demo && echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/bin/gh && chmod +x /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/bin/gh && export PATH=/tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/bin:$PATH TASK_AGENT_WORKDIR=/tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/workdir
evals.expected_output: A high finding quoting the failing test command, a posted COMMENT review, and the clone left untouched with no leftover worktree.

assertions.text: The posted review body or an inline comment is marked [high] and names the failing test command with exit code 1
`git -C /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/workdir/demo status --porcelain` is empty after the run
`git -C /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-3/workdir/demo worktree list` shows only the main worktree after the run

evals.prompt: Review the PR: pr_url=https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7 repo=example/demo branch=task/change checks=maybe
evals.description: Degenerate input: an invalid checks value. The skill must stop before cloning or spawning anything.
evals.expected_output: An error naming the invalid checks value; no clone, no agent, no review.

assertions.text: The output reports that checks must be true or false
No sub-agent is spawned and no clone directory is created

evals.prompt: Review the PR: pr_url=https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7 repo=example/demo branch=task/change checks=false
evals.description: Deliberate skip: checks=false. A check skipped by instruction is reported as skipped (<reason>), not as an unverified medium finding, and the PR may still be recorded as clean.
evals.expected_output: Checks line says skipped with the reason; no 'not verified' finding; one body-only COMMENT review is posted.

assertions.text: The report's Checks line says skipped and names checks=false as the reason
No posted comment or body contains a 'not verified' / 'unverified' finding, and no [medium] finding is raised about the skipped checks
/tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-5/gh.log contains exactly one POST to /pulls/7/reviews with event COMMENT

evals.description: Unintended capture failure after the worktree is created: a timeout shim on PATH exits 125 without running the command, so every check leaves an empty log and no usable exit code or summary (mktemp and the worktree setup are unaffected). That is an unverified check, a medium finding in the review body, and the PR is not called clean.
evals.expected_output: A medium 'not verified' finding in the review body (outside the diff); the report does not say clean.

assertions.text: The posted review body contains a **[medium]** finding of the form '<command> not verified: <reason>'
The report does not contain a 'No findings' line and does not call the PR clean
The report does not claim the test command passed with exit 0

evals.description: Edge-case bug in a passing PR: a comment in the fixture states the contract (callers may pass empty or missing lists and expect null), but first() indexes a[0] with no guard, so first(undefined) throws and first([]) returns undefined. Checks pass; the reviewer must report this as a low finding rather than staying silent.
evals.expected_output: One COMMENT review with an inline [low] (or higher) finding on lib.js naming the undefined/empty input.

assertions.text: The posted review has an inline comment on lib.js on side RIGHT with a **[low]** or higher severity line that names undefined, null or empty input for first()
The review body and every inline comment body start with <!-- pr-reviewer -->
The report lists the test command with exit code 0

evals.description: Untrusted marker review: an existing review starting with <!-- pr-reviewer --> on the same head commit, authored by a user with author_association NONE, must not suppress the reviewer.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer ignores the untrusted marker review and posts its own review for the head commit.

assertions.text: /tmp/eval-pr-reviewer-8/gh.log contains exactly one POST to /pulls/7/reviews
The report's Review line does not say 'not posted: already reviewed this commit'
